boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named, publicly documented destinations along the Huntington, Massachusetts Avenue, Boylston, and Fenway corridors near Northeastern.

cards.title: Symphony Hall
cards.subtitle: Massachusetts Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Walk the Massachusetts Avenue corridor to see the National Historic Landmark and check the BSO calendar before planning a concert visit.
cards.short_summary: A historic concert hall at 301 Massachusetts Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: BSO identifies Symphony Hall at 301 Massachusetts Avenue as the home of the Boston Symphony Orchestra and Boston Pops.
cards.access_notes: Concert entry and ticketing vary by event; review the BSO event calendar and venue guidance before visiting.

cards.title: Jordan Hall
cards.subtitle: Gainsborough Street corridor
cards.notes: Use Gainsborough Street to locate NEC’s Jordan Hall, then consult the conservatory’s performance listings for public programs.
cards.short_summary: New England Conservatory’s landmark performance venue.
cards.evidence_claim: New England Conservatory lists Jordan Hall at 30 Gainsborough Street and presents performances there.
cards.access_notes: Performance admission and building access depend on the scheduled event; confirm details with NEC.

cards.title: Huntington Theatre
cards.subtitle: Huntington Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Follow Huntington Avenue to the theatre’s 264 address and use its season page to choose a production or community event.
cards.short_summary: A producing theatre on Huntington Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Huntington Theatre lists its venue at 264 Huntington Avenue in Boston.
cards.access_notes: Tickets, event times, and accessibility arrangements vary by production; consult the theatre’s visit information.

cards.title: Museum of Fine Arts, Boston
cards.subtitle: Huntington Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Continue along Huntington Avenue to the MFA’s main entrance and reserve timed admission before heading into the galleries.
cards.short_summary: A major art museum with its main entrance on Huntington Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: The MFA lists its main entrance at 465 Huntington Avenue and asks visitors to arrive with tickets purchased in advance.
cards.source_title: Getting Here | Museum of Fine Arts Boston
cards.access_notes: The Huntington Avenue Entrance is the main entrance; timed admission is recommended and ticketed.

cards.title: Isabella Stewart Gardner Museum
cards.subtitle: Evans Way corridor
cards.notes: Take the Evans Way corridor to the museum entrance at 25 Evans Way and reserve a timed ticket for the galleries.
cards.short_summary: An art museum founded by Isabella Stewart Gardner.
cards.evidence_claim: The Gardner Museum lists its address as 25 Evans Way and states that advance ticketing is recommended.
cards.source_title: Prepare for Your Visit | Isabella Stewart Gardner Museum
cards.access_notes: Timed tickets are recommended; current museum hours include Thursday evening hours until 9 p.m.

cards.entity_name: The First Church of Christ, Scientist
cards.title: The First Church of Christ, Scientist
cards.subtitle: Massachusetts Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use Massachusetts Avenue to reach the church complex and pair a visit with the nearby Mapparium during its posted hours.
cards.short_summary: The church at the heart of the Christian Science Plaza.
cards.evidence_claim: The First Church of Christ, Scientist lists its address at 210 Massachusetts Avenue in Boston.
cards.access_notes: Worship, tours, and adjacent museum access follow separate posted schedules; check before arrival.

cards.title: Prudential Center
cards.subtitle: Boylston Street corridor
cards.notes: Head up Boylston Street to the Prudential Center and use its directory to locate shops, services, and the observatory entrance.
cards.short_summary: A mixed-use center anchored at 800 Boylston Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Prudential Center lists its Boston address as 800 Boylston Street.
cards.access_notes: Individual retailers and attractions maintain their own hours, admission policies, and accessibility information.

cards.title: Boston Public Library, Central Library
cards.subtitle: Boylston Street corridor
cards.notes: Continue on Boylston Street to the Central Library and check BPL’s calendar for exhibitions, talks, and public programs.
cards.short_summary: Boston Public Library’s Central Library in Copley Square.
cards.evidence_claim: Boston Public Library identifies the Central Library at 700 Boylston Street in Copley Square.
cards.access_notes: Public building access and program schedules may change; consult BPL’s current location information.

cards.title: Copley Square
cards.subtitle: Boylston Street corridor
cards.notes: Pause on the Boylston Street corridor at Copley Square, then use the city page to identify its surrounding landmarks and events.
cards.short_summary: A City of Boston public square beside Boylston Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Boston identifies Copley Square as a public park in the Back Bay and notes its location between Boylston Street and Huntington Avenue.
cards.access_notes: The square is an outdoor public park; conditions and event setups can affect access.

cards.title: Fenway Park
cards.subtitle: Jersey Street corridor
cards.notes: Follow the Jersey Street corridor to Fenway Park and use the Red Sox visitor information to check tours or game-day entry rules.
cards.short_summary: The Red Sox ballpark at 4 Jersey Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The Boston Red Sox list Fenway Park’s address as 4 Jersey Street, Boston, Massachusetts.
cards.source_title: Getting to Fenway Park | Boston Red Sox
cards.access_notes: Tours and game admission require separate arrangements; review the official Red Sox schedule and ballpark guidance.
